text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing that Kawakami Princess looked 
tired, I decided to have her rest in the 
infirmary."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Train hard, eat well, and rest 
plenty! That was the promise between 
PreFie and all the good kids, after all.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
—Oh my goodness!? W-Where in the world are 
we!?

text_block_list.name: Prifight
text_block_list.text: Welcome, Kawakami Princess-san!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
!? P-PreFie!? A-A-A-Are you the real 
deal!?

text_block_list.name: Prifight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's not just me! Look, why don't 
you see for yourself over there?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? Precure☆'s [Stars] and Precure♪ 
Quartet! And there's even more over 
there... Every generation is gathered 
here!?

text_block_list.name: Prifight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, we're all going to race together 
now! So, as for Kawakami Princess-san—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ehh!? Don't tell me I'm running too—

text_block_list.name: Prifight
text_block_list.text: Of course! Fufu, are you ready?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...All riiiight! Of cooourse, I am always 
primed and ready to go!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I shall run to the ends of the earth! As 
long as I am with everyone, even to the 
edge of the universe~...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? A dream?! And I was just about to 
arrive at Andromeda, too...!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh...! But I got to run all-out with 
everyone from PreFie! I feel totally 
refreshed~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Returning from the nurse's office, 
Kawakami Princess is completely back to 
full energy!

text_block_list.name: Prifight
text_block_list.text:
—I've prepared the best seats in the house 
for you! Please watch our running to your 
heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Ah, I-I understand! Th-Thank you 
very much!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, as expected of the original PreFie! 
Her late surge is truly incredible!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Being able to watch a race like this fills 
me with such emotion as a fan... 
............

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
—Waaah! But I really, truly wanted to run 
alongside everyone, you know~~!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ――Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... That felt like such an unsettling 
dream...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When Kawakami Princess returned afterward, 
it seemed she hadn't quite recovered—
